verdict.rationale: Evidence only tangentially references object storage: Cloudflare Images is described as a media pipeline to 'store, optimize, and deliver images' (cloudflare-docs-5), and R2 buckets are mentioned only as an event-subscription source ('an R2 bucket being created') in the Queues docs (cloudflare-docs-30). There's no direct documentation in the pack of R2's API, bucket creation/upload flow, or Worker bindings for storing arbitrary user uploads. Missing for 10: explicit R2 object storage docs/binding examples for uploads, code samples showing PUT/GET of user files, and any independent corroboration of using R2 for user-generated content.
